topic: Định vị tự hiểu và thiết kế đời sống

options.label: Bounded self-understanding and life-design positioning
options.scope: Position the system as reflective decision support with explicit limits; exclude diagnosis, destiny and guaranteed outcomes.
tradeoffs: Preserves the product vision and action orientation
Requires disciplined claim review across every surface

options.label: Educational wellbeing content only
options.scope: Restrict the offer to static education and journaling without individualized interpretations.
tradeoffs: Removes much of the differentiated personalized value

options.label: Pause positioning and run discovery
options.scope: Do not freeze a public position until user research and legal review are complete.
tradeoffs: Delays taxonomy, copy, product contracts and demo acceptance

recommendation_rationale: It preserves the stated vision while creating a reviewable boundary between reflection and prohibited scientific, medical or deterministic claims.
recommendation_tradeoffs: Requires ongoing Editorial, Method, Privacy and Legal review
Public copy cannot outrun evidence or product-specific gates

cost_impact.planning_effect: Option A adds recurring claim-review and research capacity; no monetary estimate is valid yet.

decision_due_event: before product narrative, public copy or pilot scope is frozen
constraints: No diagnosis, destiny, guaranteed outcome or high-impact decision claim
Every public claim must map to a product/method/content release

options.label: Lock the 9-level/12-layer/4-block/12-field/K01-K20 model as a versioned taxonomy
options.scope: Keep the complete model, publish definitions and version every semantic change.
tradeoffs: Preserves all original vision and trace IDs
Creates broad governance and regression-test obligations

options.label: Lock nine levels only and defer lower taxonomies
options.scope: Use nine levels now; treat layers, blocks, fields and K families as research-only.
tradeoffs: Delays report differentiation and method mapping

options.label: Redesign the taxonomy before implementation
options.scope: Replace the current hierarchy after a dedicated research cycle.
tradeoffs: Breaks current product/report/trace mappings and delays development

recommendation_rationale: Versioning retains all requested concepts without representing the taxonomy as validated science and gives downstream schemas stable identifiers.
recommendation_tradeoffs: More documentation and migration discipline
Definitions must be testable and cannot remain marketing labels

cost_impact.planning_effect: Option A has the largest up-front taxonomy and regression effort but avoids later ID churn.

decision_due_event: before schema, API and nine-level report contracts are frozen
constraints: Taxonomy status is conceptual until evidence says otherwise
Semantic changes require migration and downstream trace review

topic: Method độc lập theo nguồn và phiên bản

options.label: Independent versioned method releases
options.scope: Release each method by source, rights, formula, tests, limits and named approvers.

options.label: One bundled method release
options.scope: Approve the whole method set under one version and review.
tradeoffs: A defect or rights issue can block or taint the entire bundle

options.label: Content-only mode with no calculation methods
options.scope: Keep method descriptions but disable computed or individualized outputs.
tradeoffs: Cannot deliver the intended analytic product depth

recommendation_rationale: Per-method releases provide the minimum isolation needed for rights, corrections, rollback and level-specific eligibility.
recommendation_tradeoffs: Requires a release registry and independent review per method
Some catalog products remain unavailable while individual methods are blocked

cost_impact.planning_effect: Cost varies by source rights, expert review and test depth for each method.

decision_due_event: before any method result is eligible for a product or report
constraints: No release without source/right/formula/test/limit evidence
Withdrawal must invalidate dependent jobs, reports and exports

topic: Entitlement khác quyền và đủ dữ liệu

options.label: Separate entitlement, authorization, eligibility and data sufficiency
options.scope: Evaluate each server-side and return typed denial or missing-data reasons.
tradeoffs: More policy states and negative tests

options.label: Treat entitlement as sufficient access
options.scope: A paid entitlement opens a product whenever the route exists.
tradeoffs: Unsafe because payment does not prove subject rights, purpose or data sufficiency

options.label: Manual eligibility review for every request
options.scope: A reviewer approves each access and run.
tradeoffs: Does not scale and increases sensitive-data handling

recommendation_rationale: The four-way separation prevents payment or a client flag from becoming authorization and supports precise recovery states.
recommendation_tradeoffs: Requires a policy engine and cross-layer test matrix
More blocked states must be designed across mobile and desktop

cost_impact.planning_effect: Option A adds policy, authorization and cross-device state work; provider-independent estimates remain in person-days only.

decision_due_event: before entitlement, profile, analysis or report authorization contracts are frozen
constraints: Client-supplied IDs or flags cannot grant access
Every denial must avoid object-existence leakage

topic: Dừng điểm giả và cho null

options.label: Typed null, unknown, withheld and not-applicable results
options.scope: Preserve uncertainty and block unsupported derived scores while allowing partial truthful reports.
tradeoffs: Requires more schema and UI states

options.label: Impute fallback scores
options.scope: Fill missing values from defaults or heuristics.
tradeoffs: Creates false precision and unsafe downstream inferences

options.label: Fail the entire report on any missing input
options.scope: Return no result until every field is present.
tradeoffs: Unnecessarily blocks safe partial value and encourages coerced data entry

recommendation_rationale: Typed absence is the only option consistent with the plan's evidence discipline and differentiated report contracts.
recommendation_tradeoffs: Every formula and narrative path needs null behavior
Users require clear explanations of what is missing and why

cost_impact.planning_effect: Option A increases schema, fixture, UI and report-regression work.

decision_due_event: before formula, result and report schemas are accepted
constraints: Unknown is never converted to zero
AI cannot infer or narrate unavailable deterministic values

topic: Numbers là tham chiếu không đo số phận

options.label: Numbers as bounded symbolic reference
options.scope: Allow clearly labeled symbolic interpretation with sources, limitations and no fate or clinical claim.
tradeoffs: Needs prominent limitations and cultural/claim review

options.label: Numbers as predictive life metric
options.scope: Use numeric outputs to predict traits, compatibility or outcomes.
tradeoffs: Unacceptable unsupported and potentially harmful inference risk

options.label: Remove Numbers from the active portfolio
options.scope: Keep historical material only and do not expose the method.
tradeoffs: Discards a material part of the product vision

recommendation_rationale: A bounded reference mode keeps the vision visible without treating symbolic arithmetic as measurement or destiny.
recommendation_tradeoffs: May reduce persuasive marketing language
Some users may still over-interpret results, requiring UX safeguards

cost_impact.planning_effect: Option A requires source/right review, careful copy and misuse testing.

decision_due_event: before Numbers content or calculation is included in a release candidate
constraints: No prediction, diagnosis or high-impact use
Every output includes method version, source, limitation and correction path

topic: Báo cáo cấu trúc không filler

options.label: Differentiated structured reports with evidence blocks
options.scope: Use nine level-specific contracts, deterministic inputs, provenance, unknowns, actions and review states.
tradeoffs: High traceability and genuine level differentiation

options.label: One universal report template
options.scope: Reuse a single report structure and vary only length or content.
tradeoffs: Risks filler and fails nine-level differentiation

options.label: Free-form AI narrative
options.scope: Let the model compose reports without a fixed schema.
tradeoffs: Cannot reliably prove provenance, limits, corrections or stable outputs

recommendation_rationale: The structured approach is required to avoid filler and to separate deterministic facts, interpretation, uncertainty and action.
recommendation_tradeoffs: Needs nine golden fixture suites and reviewer capacity
Longer reports cannot be accepted by page count alone

cost_impact.planning_effect: Option A adds template engineering, evaluation, rendering and human review capacity.

decision_due_event: before L1 report implementation and before any report template is published
constraints: Public auto-publish remains off
Report acceptance is content- and evidence-based, not page-count-based

topic: Dòng sản phẩm mở theo gates

options.label: Open products by explicit train and exact release gates
options.scope: Keep all 23 products registered but unlock only the approved product/release/market after receipts.
tradeoffs: Preserves long-term vision and limits blast radius

options.label: Open the complete portfolio in one launch
options.scope: Ship all products once the shared platform passes.
tradeoffs: Unbounded legal, method, support and operating risk

options.label: Freeze permanently to Guest and L1
options.scope: Remove higher levels and advanced product lines from execution.

recommendation_rationale: Train-by-train release keeps all 23 products without implying that shared platform evidence clears product-specific gates.
recommendation_tradeoffs: Requires repeated candidate reviews
Commercial growth follows evidence rather than a fixed calendar

cost_impact.planning_effect: Staged release spreads cost and adds repeated review; portfolio-wide cost cannot be quoted yet.

decision_due_event: before a product train enters build beyond reversible design or synthetic fixtures
constraints: No product inherits approval from another product
Exact SHA, artifact, environment, market and expiry bind every release

options.label: Privacy, server authorization and deletion by design
options.scope: Implement identity, object/tenant policy, consent, retention, export, correction and deletion before real intake.
tradeoffs: Significant early engineering and review work

options.label: Retrofit privacy after MVP
options.scope: Collect data with basic authentication and add rights later.
tradeoffs: Creates unacceptable migration, disclosure and legal risk

options.label: Anonymous ephemeral use only
options.scope: Do not persist profiles, reports or accounts.
tradeoffs: Cannot support the planned longitudinal and commerce experience

recommendation_rationale: Personalized life data requires rights and authorization contracts before collection; later retrofit is not a safe migration plan.
recommendation_tradeoffs: Delays real-data pilots
Requires deletion/export/correction and backup implications to be rehearsed

cost_impact.planning_effect: Option A carries early security, privacy and data-lifecycle cost but avoids expensive unsafe retrofit.

decision_due_event: before any real personal data intake, persistence, sharing or migration
constraints: Synthetic fixtures only until the trust baseline is evidenced
No production data access is authorized by this packet

topic: Tám bộ nền từ source/runtime khóa

options.label: Build eight bundles from a locked, hashed source/runtime baseline
options.scope: Bind source, generation inputs, output manifest and receipts before transformation.
tradeoffs: Requires source lock and transformation tracking

options.label: Normalize and rewrite before baseline lock
options.scope: Clean the source first, then record the resulting package.
tradeoffs: Destroys provenance and makes omissions hard to detect

options.label: Exclude runtime and deployment evidence
options.scope: Package documents and source files only.
tradeoffs: Cannot substantiate current-state, integration or release claims

recommendation_rationale: A pre-transform receipt is necessary to prove all source content was retained and to separate planning artifacts from runtime evidence.
recommendation_tradeoffs: Larger package and catalog maintenance
Every regenerated export changes the final manifest

cost_impact.planning_effect: Option A adds evidence cataloging, hashing and export QA labor.

decision_due_event: before any bundle is declared complete or handed to implementation
constraints: The 149-file source package remains byte-preserved
Historical claims cannot be promoted without current receipts

options.label: Quarantine experimental legacy code and outputs
options.scope: Keep recoverable history but deny product/public selection until an explicit re-release.
tradeoffs: Preserves forensic value and prevents unsafe reuse
Requires deny rules and migration handling

options.label: Retain legacy behind a feature flag
options.scope: Allow reactivation through runtime configuration.
tradeoffs: Feature flags can bypass product, rights and safety review

options.label: Delete all legacy material
options.scope: Remove code, data and outputs permanently.
tradeoffs: Destroys provenance, rollback analysis and potential lawful records

recommendation_rationale: Quarantine balances preservation with containment and makes re-entry depend on a new reviewed release rather than a hidden switch.
recommendation_tradeoffs: Storage and inventory remain
Rollback cannot simply restore the old artifact

cost_impact.planning_effect: Option A adds inventory, deny tests and storage but avoids destructive deletion.

decision_due_event: before source bundling, migration classification or public artifact construction
constraints: No client or entitlement flag can enable quarantined output
Deletion of retained records requires separate legal/data authority

options.label: Hard method-release gate
options.scope: Require passport, source/right, formula/result contract, tests, limits and named approvers for each release.
tradeoffs: More work before each method becomes eligible

options.label: Provisional method release with partial packet
options.scope: Permit beta use when some source or test fields are pending.
tradeoffs: Normalizes missing evidence and complicates withdrawal

options.label: One product-level approval covers all methods
options.scope: Treat product approval as authorization for every included method.
tradeoffs: Cannot isolate rights, defect or limitation changes

recommendation_rationale: The hard gate is the only option that supports reproducibility, rights control and precise withdrawal across methods and reports.
recommendation_tradeoffs: Method throughput is constrained by expert reviewers
Catalog availability may be uneven

cost_impact.planning_effect: Cost depends on source licenses, expert review and per-method test complexity.

decision_due_event: before any method is referenced by an eligible analysis or report release
constraints: Missing evidence keeps release blocked
Approver must be independent of the sole author for high-risk methods

topic: Free Essentials và quota minh bạch

options.label: Bounded Free Essentials with transparent quota
options.scope: Offer one self-managed profile, core goal/journal/privacy rights and explicit compute/storage limits with graceful degradation.
tradeoffs: Requires abuse, quota and unit-economics controls

options.label: Unlimited free personalized service
options.scope: Remove usage limits for all free users.
tradeoffs: Unbounded AI, support and storage cost

options.label: No free tier
options.scope: Require payment before persistent personalized use.

recommendation_rationale: A bounded tier preserves free entry while keeping provider and support cost measurable and explaining limits honestly.
recommendation_tradeoffs: Quota UX and abuse controls add complexity
Exact limits remain blocked until provider quotes and pilot data

cost_impact.planning_effect: Quota values and marginal cost require selected providers, approved rates and observed usage.

decision_due_event: before public pricing, quota or free-tier launch copy is frozen
constraints: Missing provider cost is unknown, not zero
Quota cannot remove privacy rights or corrupt paid entitlement

options.label: Named Vietnam entity as controller and merchant
options.scope: Use a selected local entity for contracting, invoicing and controller duties after legal review.
tradeoffs: Requires entity, tax, payment and privacy analysis

options.label: Contracting entity with documented controller/processor split
options.scope: Use a selected entity and vendors under explicit data-processing and merchant responsibilities.

options.label: No commercial or real-data launch until roles are selected
options.scope: Continue planning and synthetic work only.

recommendation_rationale: No verified entity, merchant or controller decision exists; synthetic planning can continue while commercial and real-data actions remain closed.
recommendation_tradeoffs: Revenue and real-user validation wait
Legal assessment becomes a critical-path dependency

cost_impact.planning_effect: Legal, entity, tax, merchant and data-processing costs require jurisdiction-specific quotes.

decision_due_event: before contracting, invoicing, payment onboarding or real personal-data collection
constraints: This packet does not name or authorize an entity
Cross-border processing and tax duties require market-specific review

options.label: Evidence-weighted selection per provider category with adapters
options.scope: Score IdP, PostgreSQL host, payment and AI providers separately; bind decisions to contracts, regions, exits and cost caps.

options.label: Single-suite provider strategy
options.scope: Choose one ecosystem for as many categories as possible.
tradeoffs: Concentrated lock-in, outage and exit risk

options.label: Self-host all core services
options.scope: Operate identity, database and AI/payment-adjacent components directly where possible.
tradeoffs: Highest security, compliance and on-call burden; payment still needs regulated rails

recommendation_rationale: Category-specific assessment avoids inventing vendors and makes exit, data location, security and unit cost explicit before commitment.
recommendation_tradeoffs: Adapters and multi-vendor operations cost more
Selection cannot close until quotes and technical/legal evidence exist

cost_impact.planning_effect: All provider amounts remain unavailable until comparable quotes, volumes, taxes and exit costs are recorded.

decision_due_event: before provider-specific implementation, contract signature, spend or production data transfer
constraints: No provider is selected by this planning artifact
Secrets, contracts and production accounts require separate authority

options.label: A0-A1 default, gated A2, hold A3
options.scope: Permit assistive drafting and approved reversible automation; require receipts and kill switches before higher autonomy.
tradeoffs: Needs action taxonomy, monitoring and human review

options.label: A0 only
options.scope: AI may suggest but never execute or schedule actions.

options.label: Enable A0-A3 at launch
options.scope: Allow autonomous multi-step operation across eligible workflows.
tradeoffs: Unacceptable without mature controls, provider and incident evidence

recommendation_rationale: Progressive autonomy allows useful low-risk assistance while keeping high-impact or irreversible actions behind explicit evidence and approval.
recommendation_tradeoffs: More state, review and kill-switch engineering
Some promised automation remains unavailable during early phases

cost_impact.planning_effect: Option A adds monitoring, evaluation, review and incident-response capacity.

decision_due_event: before any workflow can act beyond user-confirmed reversible assistance
constraints: No payment, publication, deletion or high-impact action without explicit human authority
Global and per-workflow kill switches must be tested

options.label: Academy learning pilot without practitioner credential claims
options.scope: Launch curriculum and assessments on synthetic cases; defer certification authority until standards and complaints handling are proven.

options.label: Full practitioner certification program
options.scope: Issue credentials and permit practice under a complete standard at launch.
tradeoffs: High legal, method, assessment and supervision burden

options.label: Defer Academy entirely
options.scope: Focus only on end-user products.
tradeoffs: Removes a core adoption and quality-control channel

recommendation_rationale: A non-credential pilot preserves the Academy vision while evidence for competence, ethics, supervision and appeals is built.
recommendation_tradeoffs: Certificates cannot imply regulated or professional authority
Requires clear distinction between completion and competence

cost_impact.planning_effect: Academy cost depends on curriculum, reviewers, platform, accreditation advice and support volume.

decision_due_event: before curriculum implementation promises certification or practitioner authority
constraints: No regulated-profession implication
Assessment, appeals, suspension and complaint routes precede credential release

options.label: Tenant-isolated organization product with member-controlled private profile
options.scope: Expose only purpose-bound shared or minimum-cohort aggregate data; prohibit employer access to private profiles and high-impact profiling.
tradeoffs: Preserves organization use with privacy boundary
Limits employer analytics and requires strong RLS

options.label: Organization-administered full member profiles
options.scope: Let the organization view and manage individual analysis and reports.
tradeoffs: Creates severe consent, employment and discrimination risk

options.label: Do not offer organization features
options.scope: Keep all use individual and direct-to-user.
tradeoffs: Removes an important enterprise product line

recommendation_rationale: Member control, tenant isolation and aggregation thresholds are the minimum viable boundary for an organization offering.
recommendation_tradeoffs: Some enterprise requests must be rejected
Complex subject/tenant/grant testing and re-identification review

cost_impact.planning_effect: Option A adds tenant isolation, privacy review, enterprise support and audit capability.

decision_due_event: before organization data model, contracts or pilot recruitment are frozen
constraints: No employment, credit, insurance or other high-impact profiling
Cross-tenant denial and aggregate re-identification tests are mandatory

options.label: One reviewed country pack at a time; license before franchise
options.scope: Pilot a single market with locale, legal, support, claims and tax evidence; validate licensing before operational franchise.

options.label: Parallel multi-country launch
options.scope: Prepare and open several markets together.
tradeoffs: Multiplies legal, translation, support and operational risk

options.label: Remote software license only with no country pack
options.scope: Offer a generic partner license without local operating adaptation.
tradeoffs: May still create local legal duties and weak customer experience

recommendation_rationale: Sequential country packs keep market-specific evidence and operating capacity reviewable and avoid calling a software license a ready franchise.
recommendation_tradeoffs: Expansion cadence is evidence-limited
Reusable core still needs local legal and claim review

cost_impact.planning_effect: Country cost requires local counsel, translation, tax, payment, support and partner quotes.

decision_due_event: before selecting the first non-home market or signing a license/franchise commitment
constraints: Country approval is product- and release-specific
No franchise representation without operating, support and legal readiness

options.label: Stage-gated funding and staffing with low/base/high scenarios
options.scope: Fund the next bounded phase and release additional capacity only after decision and evidence checkpoints.

options.label: Fixed full-portfolio budget and calendar
options.scope: Approve the complete roadmap as one committed program.
tradeoffs: False precision while scope, providers and gates remain unresolved

options.label: No-spend planning only
options.scope: Continue documentation and volunteer/internal work without budget commitment.
tradeoffs: Cannot responsibly promise implementation, review or support capacity

recommendation_rationale: Stage-gated scenarios match the 452-1,039 person-day range and preserve the longer conditional portfolio horizon without inventing rates or dates.
recommendation_tradeoffs: Budget must be revisited at checkpoints
Vendor and specialist capacity may require lead time

cost_impact.planning_effect: The package has person-day ranges only; monetary scenarios require approved role rates, vendor quotes, tax and contingency.

decision_due_event: before hiring, procurement, paid vendor commitment or a delivery date is promised
constraints: Missing rates or quotes remain unavailable, never zero
Schedule separates raw capacity from gate, review and observation time
